name: setBounds
description: Move and / or resize a window; an absent field keeps its current value. A maximized or minimized window is restored first. Returns { ok: true }.

inputs.name: windowId
inputs.description: A window this connection opened (from open).

inputs.name: left
inputs.description: Screen x of the window's top-left corner, in DIPs.

inputs.name: top
inputs.description: Screen y of the window's top-left corner, in DIPs.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Window width in DIPs, at least 200.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Window height in DIPs, at least 150.
